A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the oxygen octahedral distortion and the oxygen deficiency are the main factors that cause the dislocation core to be electrically conducting.
the oxygen octahedral distortion at the dislocation is the key to the nonstoichiometry.
the oxygen octahedral distortion and the oxygen nonstoichiometry are closely correlated, which is in agreement with theoretical predictions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
atomic-resolution electron microscopy can be used for quantitative chemical analysis of complex oxides.
the atomic-scale structure of dislocations in oxides is not necessarily a simple extension of the bulk crystal structure.
the oxygen configuration is not simply determined by the local chemical environment but is also influenced by the local strain and stress.
